hooks.text: A magnetic monster at our galaxy's heart is whipping gas.
Why is the Milky Way's center throwing magnetic fits?
Our galaxy's calm center is actually a violent magnetic trap.

title: The Violent Magnetic Fits of Our Central Black Hole
description: Sagittarius A* isn't just a dark abyss; it is a magnetic monster that launches gas at 30 percent the speed of light.
